plans.name: Small
plans.tagline: For businesses just getting started with affiliate sales.
features: Custom fields - up to 1 question of your own on the Intent Form

plans.name: Large
plans.tagline: For businesses running serious volume through their Campaign Wallet.
features: Lowest 10% platform fee on every top-up
2 additional custom fields (5 total per campaign)
Branded checkout page - your logo and brand color on the customer-facing page (coming soon)
Custom integrations - connect your own site directly instead of Commission's hosted page

plans.name: Medium
plans.tagline: For businesses topping up often enough that a lower fee pays for itself.
features: Lower 15% platform fee on every top-up
2 additional custom fields (3 total per campaign)
Lead management - view and organize your leads (export not included)
Branded checkout page - your logo and brand color on the customer-facing page (coming soon)
Custom integrations - connect your own site directly instead of Commission's hosted page
